---
name: Pull Request
about: Standard template for submitting a pull request
title: "[PR] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Summary
Provide a brief description of what this PR changes or adds.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Enhancement / Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other (explain below)

## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the contributing guidelines.
- [ ] My code builds cleanly without errors.
- [ ] I added necessary tests.
- [ ] I updated documentation where required.
- [ ] I linked the PR to an existing issue (if applicable).

## Motivation / Context
Why is this PR needed? What problem does it solve?

## Implementation Details
- Describe the approach, structure changes, or algorithms used.
- Mention new modules, functions, or classes introduced.
- Highlight any breaking changes.

## Testing
- How did you test your changes?
- List manual and automated tests.
- Include sample commands, if applicable.

## Notes / Additional Comments
Any extra info, references, or context for reviewers.
